item.title: Reverze - Beyond Boundaries
item.description: Beyond the realm of expectation, lies a plain of endless potential. Paths to walk, choices to ponder and boundaries to bend. Dilute your senses and step into a world... 𝗕𝗲𝘆𝗼𝗻𝗱 𝗕𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀. Ticket sale starts on Monday, October 13 at 19:00h. Stay tuned and pre-register via the link in bio to receive the latest news and line-up updates.

item.title: Reverze - Tickets are now available!
item.description: The moment we’ve all been waiting for has finally arrived, tickets for Reverze 2026 are now available! Over 8.000 tickets were already claimed during the pre-registration sale and the demand is higher than ever. This is your moment to secure your place at the world’s biggest indoor harder styles event.

item.title: Flashback 2026 returns!
item.description: Flashback strikes once again – Saturday, May 2, 2026, at the Lotto Arena Antwerp. The night where Belgian Harder Styles history comes alive. Where the kicks hit like they used to, the anthems feel eternal and every soul returns to where it all began. Timeless classics, iconic moments and the legends who built the scene. Old memories return. New ones are forged.
